b1938.description: JVAS B1938+666 (z_l = 0.881, z_s = 2.059): JWST GO 8281 (PI Vegetti), NIRCam F115W + F277W, one visit, modules A and B, 21 exposures per detector (~24.4 h total per filter). Exclusive access ended 2026-10-01.

B1938+666.theta_e_ref: approximate: the radius of the radio Einstein ring
B1938+666.deflector_note: Lens-core flux centroid on the F115W i2d (r = 0.09-0.18", stable to 1 mas; F277W core agrees to 13 mas), 2026-10-04: 0.479" E, 0.201" S of the APT ra/dec, which is kept because it is the mosaics' CRVAL. make_stamps --center auto cuts the stamp here, snapped to the 0.06" LW grid.
B1938+666.stamp_size_note: 2026-10-04: 7" (232 SW / 116 LW px, 6.96") instead of 12". The ring is 0.45" and the lens light reaches ~2"; at 12" a third of the stamp was two detector streaks and a galaxy group to mask.
B1938+666.best_band_visual_note: Set by eye (2026-11-01): F115W, over the measured F277W, for its 0.03" pixels and sharper PSF on a 0.45" ring.

spt.description: The two SPT lenses of Lange et al. 2025: JWST GO 1355 TEMPLATES (PI Rigby), NIRCam module B only. SPT0418-47 has F115W F150W F200W + F277W F356W F444W; SPT2147-50 has F200W + F277W F356W F444W. Both also have MIRI imaging (F560W..F2100W) and NIRSpec/MIRI IFU in the same program, deliberately not reduced here (NIRCam only).

SPT0418-47.deflector_note: Lens-light peak, measure_lens_centres.py (2026-11-01): the median smoothed peak of F115W, F150W, F200W, F277W, F356W, F444W, which agree to 20 mas; +17 mas E, -23 mas N of ra/dec, which stay the mosaics' CRVAL. make_stamps --center auto cuts the stamp here, snapped to the 0.06" LW grid.

cowls_spectacular.description: The 17 'spectacular' lenses of COWLS II (Mahler et al. 2025, MNRAS 544, L8, Table 1): the top tier of the COSMOS-Web Lens Survey, JWST GO 1727 COSMOS-Web (PI Kartaltepe & Casey), NIRCam F115W + F277W and F150W + F444W, 4 dithers x 258 s per filter (SHALLOW4, 5 groups) per tile, more where tiles overlap. The F770W MIRI parallels are deliberately not reduced (NIRCam only). Lens keys are the COWLS IDs; cowls_letter is the paper's A-Q. ra/dec are the COSMOS-Web catalogue positions of the lens galaxies (Shuntov+24), so they are the mosaics' CRVAL and the stamp centre. theta_e (arcsec) is from the COWLS I PyAutoLens models (Nightingale+25), for orientation only. Redshifts are COWLS II's, with their source in redshift_*_kind; null where the paper has none (P has no lens redshift; only J, K and L have source redshifts).
cowls_spectacular.mast_query_note: COSMOS-Web targets are survey tiles (CWEBTILE-*), not lenses, so a lens is found by position: every NIRCam/IMAGE observation of GO 1727 within the mosaic field, then only the detector files whose MAST footprint overlaps the field (download_nircam.query_position).
cowls_spectacular.tweakreg_note: 2026-10-30. LW: Image3's relative tweakreg aligns the lens-covering frames first (they lead the association; expand_refcat=True, enforce_user_order=True) and grows the reference from them. With the default (expand_refcat=False) tweakwcs takes the first group in file order as the sole reference: on COSJ100013+023424 F444W a neighbouring tile's frame (obs 007), against which every lens-covering group found 0-1 matches (minobj 15), so the first reduction (2026-10-29) aligned nothing. expand_refcat alone starts from the best-overlapping pair anywhere in the field, which on COSJ095914+021219 F444W was a neighbouring visit the lens frames matched with 4 sources, so they stayed unaligned; lens-first aligned them to each other with 67 matches. SW: no fit; each frame takes the offset tweakreg gave its own exposure's LW frames (SW and LW are exposed together through one pointing). Fitted on their own, the SHALLOW4 SW frames gave fit RMSE 0.2-0.4" on 10-50 matches, and their shifts disagreed with the same exposures' LW shifts by a median 22 mas (max 113) over 204 exposures, while one visit's four LW dithers agreed to 5-30 mas.
cowls_spectacular.mosaic_field_note: 2026-10-29: 90" mosaics (not the repo's 150") and pruned intermediates, for disk. At 150" the 17 lenses need 1487 unique detector files (75 GB uncal) and ~290 MB of rate/rateints/cal per file plus a crf per lens: ~420 GB, with 248 GB free. At 90": 802 files, 40 GB uncal, ~130 GB kept (uncal + cal). Cost: ~2.25 arcmin^2 of field per lens for PSF stars and tweakreg. prune_intermediates: reduce_nircam deletes each rate/rateints once its cal exists and the Image3 crf files once the mosaic exists, so --destripe and --start rate re-run Detector1.

COSJ100119+014849.lens_note: The COWLS lens is the edge-on disc galaxy at the stamp centre: COWLS II centres it in their Figure 1, its lensed light is the faint arc ~1.1" to its upper left (theta_E 1.14"), and its position matches the ID (Dec +01:48:48.99, rounding to +014849). The round galaxy 1.7" to the SE (1.1" E, 1.3" S) is a SECOND lens system with its own arc on its west side; it is close enough to perturb the disc's lensing as a second mass component, not just as light to mask (2026-11-02).
